# ScriptText

*Common*

Styled chat text: color, formatting, hover text and click actions. Created with `scram.text()`, shown with `send(...)` of a player, the server or the context. Styles apply to this text and to appended texts that do not set their own; every method returns this text for chaining.

```js
const text = scram.text("[Shop] ").color("gold").bold(true)
    .append(scram.text("Open").color("#55ff55").underlined(true)
        .hover("Click to open the shop")
        .runCommand("/shop"));

c.getPlayer().send(text);
```

### color {#color}

::: member

Sets the color.

```js

```

| `color` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | color name (`red`, `gold`, `dark_aqua`, ...) or hex `#RRGGBB`. |

**Returns** [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) — this text.

:::
